description_expanded: Overview2 Master Suites, 4 Adult Bikes Included - Beautifully Decorated Home at NatureWalk in Seagrove -Public Beach, Heated Community Pool - `Better Now`The SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 2 Master Suites – Perfect for multiple families or couples! 4 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A in style! Great Community with Pools – Seasonal heating available! Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected & stream with ease! Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Hassle-free vacation! Driveway - 2 Cars – Limited overflow parking available.Welcome to Better NowWelcome to Better Now... just as you enter the front porch, the name of the house will all make sense. It is welcoming and comfortable. This porch is screened in with a bed swing and plenty of seating to read, relax, play cards, or catch up with family and friends.Enter the front door and into the living area is a large, open floor plan with plenty of natural light from the many windows. This beautifully decorated living room has comfortable seating and a large flat screen TV. The dining table seats 11 with extra seating for 3 at the kitchen bar. The upscale kitchen features unique tile, stainless appliances, granite counters and ample storage.You will find one of 2 master suites on this floor. This room includes a king-sized bed a large closet, and flat screen TV. The private bath features a glass door shower, separate tub, beautiful tile work and granite counters.On the 2nd floor atop the stairs is a landing area with a full-size sleeper sofa., flat screen TV and an Xbox 360. The bunk room, queen room and loft on the 2nd floor share a full bath.The 2nd master suite is on this floor with a private balcony and seating. This room has an en suite bath with stand-up shower, double vanity and a tub.We can't wait for you to book with us and enjoy, Better Now, and all that it has to offer.There are 2 Olympic size swimming pools in the community, miles of nature trails, minutes from Watercolor and Seaside. The community Gathering Place has a fire pit, hot tub, playground and entertaining bar.NatureWalk at Seagrove is a 155-acre, master-planned community surrounded by Point Washington State Forest and is located along Scenic Highway 30A corridor. Nestled within this quiet natural sanctuary, NatureWalk is just a short bike ride away from the stunning Emerald Coast beaches as well as the neighboring communities of Seaside, Seagrove and Watercolor. For excellent shopping, dining, fitness options and more, Watercolor Crossings is just steps away.*Please note The Gathering Place pool will be closed for a resurfacing project from 1/27/2025-2/28/2025.*House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (11):Master: king sized bed, private bath-downstairsBunk room: twin over full bunks, shared bathGuest Bedroom: Queen sized bed, shared bathMaster Bedroom: King sized bed, private bathCommon Area: Full size sofa sleeperAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
